12220dbf9554c598a6d60429015d4f091ebd4afb.summary: Yonhap reports that a joint government-private investigation into SK Telecom's large-scale data breach was extended to the servers of KT Corp. and LG Uplus. Per industry sources, no hacking traces had been found on those servers yet. Interim findings from a media briefing cite 25 malware variants on 23 SK Telecom servers: 24 variants of BPFDoor and one of WebCell. Two affected servers were used as temporary storage for personal data, including names, birthdates, phone numbers, email addresses and IMEI data. SK Telecom discovered the breach on April 18.

1269e37e6a2c2ba3c89a762b1d250a33e6ef30ae.summary: FireEye reports on FIN7, a financially motivated group that many vendors call Carbanak. Its phishing campaign targeted restaurant chains, hospitality and financial service organizations. Lures are DOCX or RTF files with embedded hidden LNK shortcuts. Double-clicking runs mshta.exe and VBScript, which drops PowerShell that runs a Cobalt Strike stager, and a HALFBAKED backdoor variant. Persistence uses scheduled tasks and a registry auto-start entry. FireEye started a Community Protection Event on April 12, 2017.
